title: Security & Privacy
subtitle: Your privacy is our priority. Learn how ConvertHub protects your data.

localProcessing.title: Local Processing
localProcessing.description: Everything runs in your browser. No files are uploaded to external servers.

noStorage.title: No Storage
noStorage.description: We don't store your files, form data, or personal information.

noTracking.title: No Tracking
noTracking.description: We don't use tracking cookies or sell data to third parties.

openCode.title: Transparent Code
openCode.description: Our processing is auditable in the browser.

practices: All files are processed locally using browser Web APIs
No intermediate servers are used for any conversion
Temporary files are automatically deleted when you close the tab
No metadata from processed files is stored
AES-256-GCM encryption available for sensitive files
No external service dependencies for processing

technologies.title: Technologies Used
items: Native browser Web APIs (File API, Canvas, WebAssembly)

whatWeDontDo.title: What We DON'T Do
items: We don't upload files to servers
We don't share information with third parties

reportVulnerability.title: Report Vulnerabilities
reportVulnerability.description: If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly.

contact.title: Have security questions?
contact.description: If you have any questions about how we protect your data, feel free to contact us.
